question: Most common thyroid cancer after childhood irradiation is:
explanation:
apillary thyroid carcinoma is the most common thyroid malignancy associated with previous childhood exposure to ionizing radiation. Radiation exposure causes DNA damage and can lead to characteristic genetic alterations such as RET/PTC rearrangements, increasing the risk of papillary carcinoma.



Papillary carcinoma is also the most common type of thyroid cancer overall.
